name: ayusync-monorepo
description: Vercel root configuration for AyuSync UIs

scripts.compile: npm run build:patient && npm run build:caregiver && npm run build:driver
scripts.build:patient: cd "patient ui" && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:caregiver: cd "caregiver ui" && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:driver: cd "Driver ui" && npm install && npm run build
